data.one_liner: Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech Flutter plugin with offline-first capabilities.
data.what_it_does: Provides speech recognition and speech synthesis functionality using native platform APIs. It supports listening for audio state changes, intermediate and final transcription results, and queuing text utterances for speech generation.
use_when: You need offline-capable speech-to-text or text-to-speech functionality.
You want cross-platform support across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web.
avoid_when: You need to transcribe extremely long continuous audio sessions.
You require specific platform features not covered by the plugin's parity matrix.
strengths: Cross-platform support spanning mobile, desktop, and web.
weaknesses: Speech recognition is time-limited and cannot handle very long single sessions.
Some specific advanced platform features might vary in parity.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions for audio recording and STT service usage on supported operating systems.
